pr.body:
Part of #207. Owner acceptance and closure remain on that issue.

Connections are authored on the canvas. Every selected edge has a visible Remove connection action; invalid stored endpoints and retired ports can be removed through Loop issues. Declaration editing and connected-route confirmations stay in node configuration. The modal Connections section and its keyboard creation form are removed; canvas navigation and keyboard deletion remain. [ADR-0076](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/decisions/ADR-0076-canvas-only-connection-authoring.md) records that boundary.

## Current corrected stack

Draft head `993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd`, tree `77f0af8c8276fba6761f3bc63bfa12a2d706ffa4`, targets PR #475 at `bf9f287652a23177b87488df110dfd6147acaad0`. That parent includes actual main `8fadcb0d44ac2caf80ff6279fe4648ce9398afd9`. #475 still must merge before this PR retargets to main and completes its final gates.

Claude Opus 5.5 xhigh corrected both confirmed release blockers: the first enabled connection action could be swallowed after a mouse pan, and a blank Decision route ID could strand a stored edge without a recovery action. The Canvas-owned pan gate keeps Remove/Reset attached and focusable while unavailable, then releases them after the installed D3 click blocker clears. Recovery reads exact unique stored undrawable edges even when schema validation cannot produce edge-ID diagnostics. Existing invalid-data refusals, identity checks and protected Chat guards remain.

The corrected child was frozen at `bc9094fd`. Parent integration `259b10fa` retained all 47 combined product paths and 20,495 inherited QA blobs; the only product overlap was the node dialog, which automatically combines the parent's in-place reference repair with this PR's modal retirement. Integration checks passed 196 tests across 13 files, no-emit types, scoped lint and formatting. The final merge of parent evidence into this head changed no product, test or build inputs.

## Verification and limits

- [Correction source evidence](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-final-correction/README.md): 203 focused tests and static checks passed. Old-source controls reproduced the pan ordering and blank-route recovery failures. The worker's immediately reverted intent-to-add incident is retained; root verified the empty index before its own staging.
- [Independent corrected-stack native QA](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-correction-independent/README.md): actual Edge, compiled API and file SQLite verified pan availability and the first tested available action, Remove/Reset/Undo, blank-ID device ownership/recovery, coarse input and protected Chat. Ten fixtures recorded no page errors; eight successful cases made 36 accepted browser PUTs. The two affected repository Edge tests separately passed 2/2 first attempt, zero retries. All 85 source paths, 18 embedded modules and 1,227 artifacts across 13 trees matched before/after, with cleanup verified.
- A bounded Control-drag witness established that selected-edge Remove can remain reachable. Both subsequent clicks arrived after D3's short blocker cleared; the immediate tested click worked at +12.1 ms. Overlap remains inconclusive and is explicitly assigned to formal review. This is no waiver or general node-drag fix.
- [Original pan failure](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-post-pan-cause/README.md), first fixture errors and [initial CI failure](https://github.com/Jacob-J-Thomas/GraphGoblin/blob/993d58a781ed2f0b4d13756c39e83162307b0ccd/docs/qa/2026-11-14-canvas-initial-ci/README.md) remain intact. Original Browser CI had 478 passes, one expected provider skip and one migrated Decision-route failure, without retries; the other four jobs passed.
- Eight reviewed child packets retain 515 exact files totaling 28,348,076 bytes. Earlier phase/native evidence keeps its historical scope. Current-parent native verification and new CI remain pending; the older compiled runtime is not silently promoted to the current source.
- Zero formal adversarial scans have completed. Opposite-family GPT review, final current-main integration and CI/coverage, and fresh exact-head Astra audit remain required within the three-total-scan cap.

## Post-merge owner acceptance

Record the merged build and observations on #207. Confirm that drawing, selecting and removing connections is understandable; declaration editing and connected-route confirmations are discoverable; and Loop issues makes stranded-connection recovery clear. The removed modal keyboard creation path is an explicit scope change. Machine-verifiable correctness, keyboard guards, focus and pointer behavior remain pipeline responsibilities. No owner instance/store change or owner acceptance is claimed.
